howto: Press Play. Tap the bubbles to set the animals free.
On some levels free one kind of animal.
Free enough to earn 1, 2 or 3 stars.
tips: Rainbow bubbles pop the ones around them.
Drag a finger across bubbles to pop many.

controls.keyboard: Play with the mouse; Space or Enter on Play. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap or drag over the bubbles

difficulty: 15 levels in three sea worlds. Bubbles come faster, get smaller and more kinds of animals appear; even levels ask for one kind only.

cheats.effect: No big bubbles: every bubble pops in one tap
Slow bubbles: everything rises at 60% speed
Big bubbles: every bubble is a big one

features.instant-restart: Play again on the results card
features.tutorial-card: Level 1 holds a slow bubble until you pop it
features.results: Stars card with animals freed, goal and new friends
